broad.about: a vague request with no topic: tell me something, help, what can you do
broad.label: a broad question

business_tool.about: wants a planning, estimating, reporting or governance tool for an organisation
examples: Is there a tool to estimate migration cost?
Do you have a risk register template?
How can I build a business case?
business_tool.label: a business tool

compare.about: wants two or more named things compared or told apart
examples: What is the difference between FIPS 203 and FIPS 204?
compare.label: a comparison

concept.about: wants a term, algorithm, standard or idea explained
concept.label: a concept

currency.about: wants to know whether a document or standard is still current, what replaced it, or the latest version
examples: What is the latest version of liboqs?
currency.label: what is current

dates.about: wants several dates, deadlines or a timeline, for a regulator, a region or an industry
examples: Which deadlines apply to banks in the EU?
dates.label: a fact, a date or a rule

fact.about: wants one specific value about one named thing: an owner, a size, a status, a single date
examples: How big is an ML-KEM-768 public key?
fact.label: a fact, a date or a rule

learning.about: wants to find lessons or learning material on the site on a topic
examples: Where can I learn about hybrid certificates?
Is there a module on HSMs?
learning.label: learning material

list.about: wants the members of a kind of thing listed
examples: What are the workshop steps in PQC 101?
list.label: a list

name.about: the whole question is the name of one thing
name.label: a name

not_fact.about: asks for a prediction, an opinion, personal advice, or something no document can state as fact
examples: Is my company safe from quantum attacks?
not_fact.label: a prediction or opinion

people.about: wants to know who a person or organisation is, or who leads or works on something
examples: Who are the authors of Kyber?
What is the Post-Quantum Cryptography Coalition?
people.label: people or organisations

planning.about: wants to know how an organisation should start, sequence or run its post-quantum migration
examples: How should a bank start its PQC migration?
What is the first step of a migration roadmap?
planning.label: planning

products.about: wants products, vendors, libraries or hardware that support something
examples: Which vendors have FIPS validated PQC?
products.label: products or vendors

risk.about: wants to understand the quantum threat itself: who or what is exposed, how soon, what attackers can do
examples: What is harvest now, decrypt later?
Which of my encryption is at risk from quantum computers?
How does Shor's algorithm threaten RSA?
risk.label: quantum risk

rules.about: wants what a regulation, mandate or framework requires or obliges
examples: What are the PCI DSS crypto requirements?
rules.label: a fact, a date or a rule

site.about: asks about the website: what is new, where a page is, how to use a feature, what the site covers
examples: How do I switch my role?
site.label: the site itself

source_document.about: wants to find a specific document, standard text or PDF
examples: Where can I read the NIST IR 8547 draft?
source_document.label: a source document

technical_tool.about: wants to try something hands-on: generate keys, run a handshake, benchmark, inspect a certificate
examples: Where can I try ML-KEM in the browser?
Can I generate an ML-DSA key pair here?
Is there a TLS handshake simulator?
technical_tool.label: a tool

answer_text.default: Here is what the Hub holds on this.
answer_text.name: One Hub record matches that name.
answer_text.name_several: Several Hub records match that name. Choose one.

failure.data_not_loading: The Hub could not load the data for this answer.
failure.held: Your question is kept in the box below. Nothing was lost. Try again, or keep browsing the Hub.

note.broad: Broad match: the Hub has no direct answer to this. These are the closest resources.
note.direct: Grouped for {label}: best first, up to 3 per group.
note.name: Matched by name: one Hub record, shown above. Related resources follow, best first, up to 3 per group.
note.no_direct: Grouped for {label}: best first, up to 3 per group. No direct answer: resources only.
note.not_fact: The Hub does not state this as a fact and gives no personal advice or prediction. These are the closest resources.

cert-engineer.why: works from the standards and the validation records

curious.why: is learning; lessons first, then plain readings

developer.why: builds and tries things; tools first, then the lesson behind them

grc.why: compliance work starts from the rule and its source document, then the data

ops.why: runs the estate; tools and product or vendor records first

researcher.why: reads the papers and standards first, then the lessons and records
